name: RNG Battles! ⚔️
desc:
⚔️ RNG Battles is a RNG and Fighting game combined! Battle with or against other players in different modes with random Weapons and Armor you roll! Earn coins to purchase upgrades and boost your Luck! 🍀
👍 Give the game a Like! Game updates at 160,000 Likes!


🗡️ Roll 400+ Weapons for Free!
🛡️ Roll Armors to increase your health!
👑 Fight other players to become the last one standing!
💰 Earn coins from Battles!
🛠️ Unlock & craft upgrades!
🗺️ Battle on different maps!
🏆 Take over the leaderboards!


🖥️ Controls
ATTACK - Left Click/LT/L2/Tap UI Button
BLOCK - Right Click/RT/R2/Tap UI Button
DASH - Q/SQUARE/X-Button/Tap UI Button


Wins and Elims don't count in Private Servers!

Join "RNG123" group for "FAN" tag and +100 Coins! 💰

🍀 Made by RNG123
